scene.language: This scenario is modeling a check seen in soccer. There's an opponent, a coach, and a teammate. To create space for the teammate, the coach will check to either side of the teammate, and then the opponent will naturally follow. [0][1](ball thudding) Because the coach checks first, the opponent naturally will take some time to follow the coach, and this will give the coach extra space. The teammate will now pass to the coach. [2][3][4]The coach has now received the ball, but notice that the opponent is right there, and there's no space to turn. If the opponent was farther away, the coach could turn and dribble forward, but now that the opponent is so close, the coach has to pass it back to the teammate. But still, this creates space for the other side of the field.[5][6][7]
